title: Not enough value but convenient
text: Few products included for the price. The catnip toys are similar to what I can find at the dollar stores for a couple of bucks at the most. I feel it’s mainly paying for the convenience (covering time spent shopping and driving to the store, the price covering the shipping, box, etc). The treats were a small bag but good quality. I’ll stick with it a couple more months and update on the value.
label: neutral
